title: Mid-Hudson Taiwanese Association 哈德遜中區臺灣同鄉會
content_html: The Mid-Hudson Taiwanese Association (MHTA) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (全美台灣同鄉會), serving the Taiwanese American community in the Mid-Hudson Valley area of New York State. It is listed under the TAA’s East Northern (美東北) regional grouping alongside other New York and mid-Atlantic chapters.
